messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT - multiple publish steps failing: GitHub Actions & Packages returning 5xx on push/publish. Affects artifact publishing for hotfix pipelines. Please acknowledge and start incident channel. https://www.githubstatus.com/

Maria Hsu: acknowledged. I'm taking initial coordination. Summary: hotfix pipelines for Zephyr Labs payment retry fix blocked at image/npm publish to GH Packages. Need quick mitigations for customer-facing rollback/hotfix.

Priya Singh: which workflows are failing? full list?

Maria Hsu: failing: infra/service-api-hotfix (docker push -> ghcr.io/redwood/service-api:hotfix), web/ui-hotfix (npm publish -> npm.pkg.github.com/@redwood/ui), and internal builder image pushes. Error samples: `503 Service Unavailable` and `500 server error`. snippet: ```
npm ERR! code E503
npm ERR! 503 Service Unavailable - PUT https://npm.pkg.github.com/@redwood%2fui
```

Daniel Wu: We have cached images for main in our GCS artifact-store but not for hotfix branches. Options: 1) manual push to Docker Hub and override image pulls; 2) use our internal registry (artifact-store) if we can convert images to tar and upload; 3) delay production deploy until GH recovers. Which is acceptable?

Maria Hsu: SLA: Zephyr is on a critical incident and needs fix ASAP. We'll attempt option 1 first (Docker Hub). Priya, can you try pushing the hotfix image to docker.io and trigger a canary override?

Priya Singh: doing local build -> tag -> push. Commands: ```
docker build -t redwood/service-api:hotfix-2002512345 .
docker tag redwood/service-api:hotfix-2002512345 docker.io/redwood/service-api:hotfix-2002512345
docker push docker.io/redwood/service-api:hotfix-2002512345
```

deploy-bot: Note: Deploy requests using non-GH registries require image override flag and audit approval if prod.

Priya Singh: push succeeded to docker.io. Will trigger canary with image override: `deploy --env canary --image docker.io/redwood/service-api:hotfix-2002512345 --force`. Kicking off.

Support - Lina Park: customers reaching out re: degraded payments. I'll update status page: "Upstream GitHub Actions / Packages outage preventing artifact publishing. We're implementing temporary deployment workarounds for priority customers."

oncall-bot: 30m update cadence started by Maria Hsu. Handoff scheduled to Daniel Wu in 40m.

Daniel Wu: canary coming up... pods pulling docker.io image OK, readiness checks passing. Observability note: tracing is normal, but some dashboards still reflect old metric timestamps — might be caching in our metrics vendor (separately investigating).

Maria Hsu: good. For the UI package, npm publish blocked. Can we instead host the compiled bundle on S3 and point CDN for the hotfix?

Daniel Wu: yes. I'll upload the build artifact to s3://redwood-temp-ui/hotfix-2002512345 and create a signed URL + temporary CDN route for canary.

Priya Singh: canary for service-api looks healthy after 5 mins. No errors on payment retry tests. Recommend proceeding to controlled prod rollout.

Maria Hsu: Proceeding to prod using docker.io artifact. Reminder: document temporary registry usage and schedule relicensing/cleanup. Raj (not on call) please help claim any billing/credentials follow-ups later.

deploy-bot: Prod deploy approved by Maria Hsu. Rollout strategy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m observation windows.

gha-bot: GitHub Status: 2026-03-16T00:12Z - "Investigating: Some users are experiencing issues with Actions and Packages" - https://www.githubstatus.com/incident/xyz789

Support - Lina Park: sent customer message to Zephyr: "We're mitigating an upstream GitHub outage by using temporary registries and CDN-hosted UI bundles. We expect service restored in under 30 minutes for your account. We'll provide a post-incident report."

Daniel Wu: Prod rollout at 50% -> no regressions. Proceeding to 100%.

Maria Hsu: keep running the on-call cadence. Document commands used in case we need to repeat. Also open an internal ticket to request GitHub incident timeline & credits.

gha-bot: 2026-03-16T00:45Z - "Partial Recovery: Actions and Packages showing recovery for some customers."

Priya Singh: noticed intermittent success to GH now. Will not attempt to re-push to GH Packages until stable for 15m. We should also revert to ghcr.io once confirmed.

Daniel Wu: prod checks green. Payment flows healthy for Zephyr. Cleaning up: removing temporary CDN entry and scheduling image cleanup from docker.io. Note: we should keep the docker.io artifact for 24h in case of rollbacks.

Maria Hsu: action items for postmortem: 1) Prebuild and store hotfix artifacts (GCS/S3 immutable) for all deployable services, 2) document alternate registries and wrapbook runbook steps, 3) add test that exercises publishing to alternate registry in disaster drills, 4) request GH SLA credit & timeline. I'll own the postmortem.

Support - Lina Park: I'll follow up customers once postmortem is published.

Maria Hsu: closing this incident thread. Thanks everyone for quick work. :white_check_mark:
